mapper.sql: FROM crm_contact t JOIN crm_customer c ON c.id=t.customer_id LEFT JOIN sys_user o ON o.id=c.owner_id
mapper.select: SELECT t.*,c.company_name,o.real_name AS owner_name ORDER BY t.is_primary DESC,t.id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT t.*,c.company_name,o.real_name AS owner_name WHERE t.id=#{id}
SELECT t.*,c.company_name,o.real_name AS owner_name WHERE t.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM crm_contact WHERE customer_id=#{customerId} AND is_primary=1 AND status=1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.id,c.company_name FROM crm_customer c LEFT JOIN sys_user o ON o.id=c.owner_id WHERE c.owner_id IS NOT NULL
AND c.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_contact SET is_primary=0 WHERE customer_id=#{customerId} AND is_primary=1
UPDATE crm_contact SET is_primary=1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status=1
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM crm_contact WHERE customer_id=#{customerId} AND status=1 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
